recorded_before: any inference on the public task variant
reason: Privacy (owner decision): exact asset areas and Hansen-derived event areas could allow re-identification of real parcels via the public cadastre. Real area values are replaced by synthetic equivalents before public release.

change.tasks: dataset/tasks.jsonl is the PUBLIC variant derived from the preregistered tasks_v0.1.jsonl (sha256 in PREREGISTRATION.lock.json).
change.method: Every distinct area value >= 2.0 ha per case replaced by round(v*f,1) with an independent secret factor f in [0.65,0.89] U [1.15,1.50]; values < 2 ha kept; forest-type components re-summed; share_of_asset_pct recomputed; only number tokens followed by 'ha'/'%' (and escaped numbers in detector patterns) changed in questions, answer keys, allowed/forbidden claims and rationales.
constraints_verified: method thresholds 0.5 ha, 2 ha and 2 % preserved per value
no original identifying value present in public files

unchanged: questions and answer keys (except substituted area numbers)
models, serving stack and decoding parameters

rebaseline.re-run: 66 changed tasks x 3 conditions x 3 runs x 4 models = 2,376 responses; 4,752 judgments
rebaseline.reused: 16 unchanged tasks (identical prompts, verified by SHA-256): 576 responses, 1,152 judgments from 2026-11-13
rebaseline.public_baseline: the new public baseline replaces the development run for all published numbers

development_run: The original run on real values is kept only in the internal archive; its aggregate results may be cited as a development run.
exploratory: Invariance analysis (original vs synthetic values, 66 tasks, paired) is exploratory and will not change the experiment.
